$meta.name: Troupe — Afterglow
$meta.description: Void and pit under cream, and two lights on it: pink is you being asked, cyan is the machine working. The stage after the house lights go down.
$meta.reservedColour: status.waiting — pink #FF0080 / #C4005F. Afterglow also spends it as the brand's accent: the mask's lit half, links and the current nav item. Denied and error are clay so they never read as the reserved colour.
$meta.source: ../afterglow.dc.html is the comp, and it is dark only. The dark values are its custom properties (the oklch cyan and amber converted to sRGB); the light values are derived from them: the ground inverts to cream and every accent darkens until it clears the same contrast floor as the other themes.

$themeContract: Every colour token carries a dark and a light value under one semantic name. Components read the name, never a hex. All four Troupe themes expose exactly this token set — swapping a theme swaps values only. A theme that needs a new token name is a redesign, not a theme.

shadow.description: The one hard shadow: a flat block offset down and right under a tile or a primary button, never blurred. The offset is the component's; this is its colour.

body.description: Long-form reading, a step below primary so the headings lead.

label.description: Form labels, breadcrumbs and the mono labels that name a region.

muted.description: The comp's grey-deep (#6A6A82) lifted a step: at 3.7:1 on the void it was under the floor every theme is held to.

accent.description: The brand where it is not a status: the current nav item's edge. Afterglow spends its reserved pink here; the other themes keep their reserved colour for waiting alone and use their link blue.

running.description: An agent is working right now. Cyan: the machine's colour.

waiting.description: Stopped, waiting for a human decision. The reserved colour.

queued.description: Accepted but not yet started, and the list's idle fallback. Quiet grey, like the comp's STOPPED: the comp's amber QUEUED pill on a held message has no token of its own yet.

local.description: Runs on this machine and never leaves it. The comp's amber.

allowed.description: Decision record: the action was permitted. The machine may go on, so it is the machine's cyan.

denied.description: Decision record: the action was refused. Clay, not the reserved pink and not the error red.

dormant.description: Session asleep. Costs nothing, wakes on the next message. Violet.

readonly.description: Access withdrawn or archived. Readable, not writable.

private.description: Session belongs to one person, or to the people invited to it. Violet, like asleep: a quiet state, not an alarming one.

error.description: Something failed. Reserved for failure, never for denial: hotter than clay.

offline.description: Connection lost or platform unreachable. A dimmer tan than the amber of queued.

footlight.use: The approval panel only. The panel's own pink edges are borders; this is the glow under them.

sans.description: Interface and reading. Geometric, with the black weights the headlines are set in, and Danish diacritics at every weight.

mono.description: Anything literal — paths, commands, diffs, identifiers — and every label and pill.

screen.description: The screen face. Section labels only, `// LIKE THIS`, and a device code. Never body text.

display.use: The wordmark on the launcher, and nothing else.

subheading.use: Row titles, tile titles, group headings.

uiSmall.use: The sentence under a title, secondary copy, notes.

micro.use: Labels, pills, counts, relative times. Upper case and tracked: the comp's mono label.

screen.use: `// SECTION` labels that name a region of a screen.

code.use: Commands, file paths, inline code, profile names.

wordmark.use: The word 'troupe' beside the mask. Always lowercase in the rail; the launcher alone sets it in capitals with the last two letters in pink.

reading.description: Max line length for the conversation and long copy.

space.$note: The comp's scale runs 4, 8, 12, 16, 22, 28, 38, 52. Steps 9 to 11 continue it for the few screens that breathe more than a session does.

radius.$note: Afterglow is square. Every radius is zero; the names stay so a component that asks for one gets an answer in every theme.

border.$note: marker is the left edge that flags a row or panel as needing attention; heavy is the approval panel's top edge. Strong borders differ from hairlines by opacity, not by width.

rules: Every animation is idempotent: a server-driven DOM replacement may restart it at any time, and restarting must look acceptable.
Nothing animates except a state genuinely in motion: running, waiting, reconnecting, waking, and the caret while the troupe writes.
A tile lifts two pixels on hover and its hard shadow grows to match. Nothing else moves.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all durations to instant and replaces pulses with static marks.

min.description: Hard floor. Everything must work here.

md.description: Backstage becomes a side panel instead of a sheet.

lg.description: Session list rail appears beside the conversation.

touchTarget.description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, approvals included.

switchTrack.description: Tool on/off switch track. Knob 18px, travel 18px.

mark.$note: The mask. One silhouette, split down the middle: the filled half is what the agent did alone, the hollow half is what still needs a person.

seam.description: Drop the seam line below 32px and let the colour change be the seam.

rules: Fill the mask with the surface behind it, never a colour outside the token set.
An eye on a filled half is cut out of it; an eye on a hollow half is solid.
People never get a mask. A human is initials in a ring.
